import json
parent = hou.node("/obj/alien_spaceship_main")
# Group nodes by type pattern
type_groups = {}
for child in parent.children():
    t = child.type().name()
    if t not in type_groups:
        type_groups[t] = []
    type_groups[t].append(child.name())

# Sort by count descending
sorted_groups = sorted(type_groups.items(), key=lambda x: -len(x[1]))
lines = []
for t, names in sorted_groups:
    lines.append(f"{t} ({len(names)}): {', '.join(names[:8])}" + ("..." if len(names) > 8 else ""))
print("\n".join(lines))
